record.issue_text: The loadUsers rewrite in handleNewBooking.ts:724-762 swallows errors: the catch block converts every unexpected error into a generic 500 'Unable to load users' (masking root causes) while leaking raw Prisma error messages to the client as 400, and the dynamicUserList guard error also becomes a 500 instead of the presumably-intended 400.

adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the rewritten loadUsers() wraps all logic in a try/catch and throws a plain Error when `!Array.isArray(dynamicUserList) || dynamicUserList.length === 0` ("dynamicUserList is not properly defined or empty."). That Error is not a HttpError or `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError`, so the catch converts it into `new HttpError({ statusCode: 500, message: "Unable to load users" })`, turning an input/validation problem into a 500. Additionally, for `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` it rethrows a 400 with `message: error.message`, which can expose raw Prisma error text to the client and masks the original error classification.
